parts.how: Structured fabric tote body with fixed panel seams and base shape as in refs.
Full-length top zipper with two pulls; no flap, no magnetic snap primary closure.
Dual short top handles stitched to the rim; no crossbody strap unless shown in refs.
Zipper pulls and rivets in the reference metal finish; do not swap to gold/chrome inventively.

forbid: do not replace the top zipper with a flap, buckle, or drawstring
do not invent exterior pockets, logos patches, or straps not in refs
do not change handle length/attachment points or add a shoulder strap
do not redesign the base silhouette or panel count

no third-party logos, wordmarks, or brand-identifiable devices (MacBook, iPhone, Apple logo, Nike swoosh, Starbucks cup mark, Amazon smile, Google/Microsoft hardware logos) unless the advertised SKU is that brand or the user explicitly approved it
immutable.colors: Shell and lining colors as in refs; hardware finish locked.
immutable.logos: none — do not invent brand patches
immutable.proportions: Tote height/width/depth ratio and handle arc match refs.

notes: Open shots may unzip (states) but must keep the same zipper track and handle attachment.
